images.author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility (IRF), NIH
images.why: Caption identifies patient-isolated SARS-CoV-2 particles imaged by TEM and color-enhanced at NIAID IRF. Strong candidate for emphasizing individual virions. Linked Flickr rendition is limited to 1024 px; download could not be verified.

images.author: NIAID Rocky Mountain Laboratories, NIH
images.why: Caption identifies yellow SARS-CoV-2 particles emerging from blue/pink cultured cells, isolated from a US patient. Colorized SEM from the requested RML laboratory. Linked rendition is limited to 1024 px; download could not be verified.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
images.why: Caption identifies orange SARS-CoV-2 particles infecting a teal cell, isolated from a patient and captured by SEM at NIAID IRF. Strong complementary colors for a full-bleed crop. Source exposes a 3000 px rendition; download could not be verified.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
images.why: Caption identifies pink particles of a SARS-CoV-2 variant infecting a purple cell, isolated from a patient sample; colorized SEM from NIAID IRF. Source exposes a 3000 px rendition; download could not be verified.

images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
images.why: Caption identifies green SARS-CoV-2 particles heavily infecting a red apoptotic cell; patient-derived sample imaged by SEM at NIAID IRF. Vivid contrasting colors. Source exposes a 3000 px rendition; download could not be verified.
